prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a modern car dashboard, focusing on the central infotainment screen displaying a navigation map with turn-by-turn directions. The screen shows a clear, colorful interface with a blue route line, green and gray map details, and a prominent instruction to make a U-turn. The dashboard is sleek and contemporary, featuring a honeycomb-patterned air vent below the screen and tactile control knobs on either side of the display. The left side of the frame includes a partial view of the steering wheel and a driver’s hand, suggesting motion and engagement with the vehicle. The lighting is natural daylight, casting soft, even illumination across the dashboard, with subtle reflections on the glossy surfaces. The color palette is dominated by cool grays, blacks, and metallic accents, contrasted by the vibrant colors of the navigation screen. The composition is tight and immersive, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the screen and dashboard details, evoking a sense of modern technology and purposeful travel.
